defaultThresholds.note: Used when a group record omits its own thresholds. FNV's variance is the design — instances should override. On our 0..25 tally scale, Goodsprings' 3/8/15 shape fits; Legion-class groups would carry proportionally higher rows (their 15/50/100 is on FNV's unbounded quest-fame scale).

gridAxes.fameBand: row index 0..3 = band(tally vs thresholds): 0 below range2, 1 at range2, 2 at range3, 3 at range4

hatedFloor.note: Once a group's infamy (RAW, undecayed) reaches its hate threshold (group record's hateThreshold, defaulting to its range4), the group never reads the Ranger Unmarked again (#270): if derivation would produce the Unmarked cell, the floorLabel is read instead. A pardon zeroes a pile; the floor flag is a separate fact the pardon does not clear unless its authored row says so (TRANSFER-MAP §2.4).

ladderCoord.note: A standing is PLACED on #271's ladder as a coordinate — a pointer at the grid combination (cell = fameBand * 4 + infamyBand, with the two bands carried alongside). It is never an arithmetic difference of the tallies: fame - infamy anywhere in code is a landing defect, the same class as a stored morale value (#270).

mixed.note: Both bands at minBand or above = the mixed flag (#270's both-piles-high case): the group holds two true stories and behaves helped-and-wary, welcomed-and-watched. #271's draft prefix for a mixed standing at any band is 'Two-Storied'; the interior grid cells for mixed combinations carry their own draft names above.

note: The standing grid for #270 reputation (honor-west TRANSFER-MAP §2.2), landed by the honor wiring P0 (2026-10-29). A group's standing is a NAMED COMBINATION of its fame band x its infamy band — sixteen draft names, FNV's shape. All label words are DRAFT data (owner slot §5.1 applies to band vocabulary; renaming is a data edit).
